text:
Next week's menu, 450 pupils a day:
Mon meatball sauce with potatoes
Tue fish fingers with mashed potatoes
Wed vegetable soup with bread
Thu chicken curry with rice
Fri pea soup with pancakes

assumptions: Next week taken as Mon 2026-11-16 to Fri 2026-11-20.
Dairy in all dishes (mashed potatoes, pancakes, sauces) is lactose-free per kitchen rules.
Bread served with vegetable soup is a plain nut-free bread, a side.
Pancakes served with pea soup are a dessert course, as is traditional in Finland.

dishes.name: Meatball sauce
dishes.method: Bake meatballs in the oven and simmer in a lactose-free cream and stock sauce.

ingredients.name: Ground beef
ingredients.amountBasis: 4 meatballs of about 17 g raw each

ingredients.name: Beef stock concentrate
ingredients.amountBasis: concentrate for about 4 ml stock per cover

dishes.name: Boiled potatoes
dishes.method: Boil peeled potatoes in salted water until tender.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.amountBasis: 200 g peeled portion, 80% yield after peeling: 200/0.8

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amountBasis: about 1 percent of cooking water, part absorbed

dishes.name: Fish fingers
dishes.method: Bake ready-made fish fingers in the oven.

dishes.name: Mashed potatoes
dishes.method: Boil potatoes and mash with lactose-free milk and lactose-free butter.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.amountBasis: 200 g portion of mash, about same weight as peeled potato, so raw weight is portion divided by yield

ingredients.name: Lactose-free milk
ingredients.amountBasis: about 2 dl milk per kg of potatoes

ingredients.name: Lactose-free butter
ingredients.role: Adds richness and flavour to the mash
ingredients.amountBasis: about 40 g butter per kg of potatoes

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.role: Seasoning for cooking water and mash
ingredients.amountBasis: about 1 percent of the portion weight

dishes.name: Vegetable soup
dishes.method: Simmer root vegetables and cabbage in vegetable stock until tender.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.role: root vegetable, body of the soup

ingredients.name: Swede
ingredients.role: root vegetable, typical Finnish soup flavour

ingredients.name: Vegetable stock concentrate
ingredients.amountBasis: about 1 g concentrate per dl of liquid, 3.5 dl portion

ingredients.name: Sliced bread, nut-free
ingredients.role: Served as the bread slice with vegetable soup
ingredients.amountBasis: 1 slice, 40 g as stated in the portion

dishes.name: Chicken curry
dishes.method: Fry chicken with onion and curry, add coconut milk and stock, and simmer until done.

ingredients.name: Chicken breast
ingredients.amountBasis: 200 g portion with sauce, about 55% meat

dishes.name: Boiled rice
dishes.method: Boil rice in salted water until tender.

ingredients.name: Long grain rice
ingredients.role: main component of the side dish
ingredients.amountBasis: 200 g cooked, rice about 2.7x weight when boiled

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amountBasis: about 1% of the cooking water, partly stays in water

dishes.name: Pea soup
dishes.method: Simmer soaked dried peas with ham or pork and onion until soft.

ingredients.name: Dried yellow peas
ingredients.amountBasis: about 50 g dry peas per 3.5 dl portion

ingredients.name: Smoked ham or pork
ingredients.role: Meat and flavour for the soup
ingredients.amountBasis: about 40 g meat per portion of soup

ingredients.name: Yellow onion
ingredients.amountBasis: small amount of onion per portion

dishes.name: Pancakes
dishes.method: Bake a batter of lactose-free milk, eggs and flour in oven trays.

ingredients.name: Lactose-free milk
ingredients.amountBasis: oven pancake batter, about 1 dl milk per piece plus a little extra

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.amountBasis: about 1 egg per 2 portions of oven pancake

options.title: Carrot instead of swede
options.effect: Carrot simmers tender in the same time and gives a sweeter, mild soup that pupils usually like.

options.title: Whole swede, cut in kitchen
options.effect: Same flavour as planned, but needs peeling and dicing in the kitchen; whole swede may be an available product.

options.title: Potato instead of swede
options.effect: Potato cooks tender and makes the soup slightly thicker and milder, losing the swede flavour.

options.title: Dried onion granules
options.effect: Dried onion gives the same sweet onion flavour in the meatballs at about a third of the fresh weight.

ingredient.name: Dried onion granules
ingredient.amountBasis: dried weight, about one third of fresh onion

options.title: Frozen diced onion
options.effect: Frozen chopped onion works in meatball mix and sauce with the same flavour, slightly softer texture.

options.title: Leek instead of onion
options.effect: Finely chopped leek gives a milder onion note to the meatballs and sauce.

ingredient.name: Leek
ingredient.amountBasis: trimmed weight from whole leek, white and light green parts

options.title: Frozen breaded fish portions
options.effect: Oven-baked breaded fish fillet portions take the place of the fingers; the dish is much the same, but the shape differs.

ingredient.name: Breaded fish fillet portion, frozen
ingredient.amountBasis: ready-made frozen weight, baked from frozen

options.title: Oven-baked white fish with crumb
options.effect: Plain frozen white fish fillets are coated in flour and breadcrumbs and baked, giving a similar crispy fish dish made in the kitchen.

ingredient.name: White fish fillet, frozen (pollock, cod or similar)
ingredient.role: main item, coated and baked in oven

options.title: Smaller portion, more sides
options.effect: Cuts the fish to 80 g per cover and adds a bit more of the side dishes, so a smaller supply of fingers is enough.

options.title: Frozen carrot cubes
options.effect: Frozen carrot gives the same sweetness and colour and simmers tender in the soup.

ingredient.name: Carrot, frozen diced or sliced
ingredient.amountBasis: Frozen, already peeled and cut, so no trimming loss.

options.title: Swede instead of carrot
options.effect: Swede is a sweet root vegetable that simmers tender like carrot, but the soup is paler and slightly milder.

ingredient.name: Swede, fresh
ingredient.amountBasis: Fresh swede, peeled; amount is the cooked weight per cover.

options.title: Parsnip and potato soup
options.effect: Parsnip adds sweetness in place of carrot, so the soup is a paler root vegetable soup.

ingredient.name: Parsnip, fresh
ingredient.amountBasis: Fresh parsnip, peeled; amount is the cooked weight per cover.

options.title: Savoy or pointed cabbage
options.effect: Another fresh cabbage that simmers tender in the soup with a slightly milder, sweeter taste.

ingredient.name: Pointed cabbage
ingredient.amountBasis: raw weight trimmed, simmered until tender

options.title: Frozen cabbage or mixed veg
options.effect: Frozen cut cabbage simmers tender in the soup and keeps the same texture and role.

ingredient.name: Frozen cabbage
ingredient.amountBasis: frozen weight, added directly to the simmering stock

options.title: Extra root vegetables instead
options.effect: Soup becomes a root vegetable soup with more swede, carrot and potato and no cabbage.

ingredient.name: Swede
ingredient.role: root vegetable replacing cabbage as the tender vegetable body
ingredient.amountBasis: raw peeled weight, simmered until tender

options.title: Unpeeled potatoes, peel in kitchen
options.effect: Same boiled potatoes, but the kitchen peels or boils them in their skins; needs more raw weight for peeling loss.

ingredient.name: Potato, unpeeled, firm boiling variety
ingredient.amountBasis: raw weight with skin; about 15% lost in peeling, giving about 250 g peeled per cover

options.title: Frozen whole potatoes
options.effect: Boiled whole potatoes from frozen, already peeled; texture slightly softer.

ingredient.name: Potato, peeled, whole or halved, frozen

options.title: Boiled rice instead
options.effect: Potatoes are replaced by boiled rice as the side, so guests get a different dish.

ingredient.name: Long-grain rice, dry
ingredient.amountBasis: dry weight, boiled in salted water
